_meta.note: Canonical product catalog for Dew Theory. Wholesale/retail figures are from the client's product line document. Ingredient, usage, and skin-type data were researched against Skin Script's own product pages and multiple authorized Skin Script retailers, then paraphrased — they are NOT invented, but should still be read and confirmed by Emily before publishing, since formulas are occasionally revised by the manufacturer. 2026-09-19 Emily confirmation pass: she has not confirmed the remaining catalog decisions. Engineered defaults stay in place and stay explicitly unconfirmed — Sheer Protection SPF retail ($30, retail_price_confirmed=false), Lip Treatment as one Peppermint/Pomegranate product (see manufacturer_name_note + OPEN_ITEMS.md §2), Botanical Bloom size 2 oz (size_confirmed=false), and DEW15 15% as a launch-promo placeholder only. Do not flip honesty flags to true or claim Emily approved these without a new owner answer.
_meta.pricing_rule: retail_price = wholesale_price x 2, applied uniformly. Confirmed against 7 of 8 client-supplied pairs; the 8th (SPF) had no retail figure in the source document and was computed with the same formula — flagged for confirmation, not treated as given fact. Emily still must confirm the SPF retail; retail_price_confirmed remains false until she does.

products.name: Green Tea Citrus Cleanser

key_actives.name: Green Tea (Camellia Sinensis) Leaf Extract + EGCG
key_actives.function: Antioxidant; helps limit acne-causing bacteria while protecting the skin's healthy microbiome.

key_actives.name: Grape Seed Extract
key_actives.function: Polyphenol-rich antioxidant; supports skin balance and calms redness.

key_actives.name: Grapefruit & Lemon Peel Oil
key_actives.function: Vitamin C source; clarifies and brightens, contributes the citrus scent.

key_actives.name: Wild Cherry Bark Extract
key_actives.function: Soothing, anti-inflammatory.

products.how_to_use: Apply to damp skin, massage in circular motions for about 60 seconds to emulsify and lift impurities, then rinse with warm water.
products.description_short: A foaming gel cleanser built around green tea and citrus extracts — clarifies oily and combination skin without over-stripping it.
products.image_alt: Skin Script Green Tea Citrus Cleanser on Dew Theory sage background

products.name: Mandelic Brightening Serum
products.category_note: Named 'serum' by the manufacturer, but functions as a leave-on chemical exfoliant — categorized as Exfoliant per client instruction.

key_actives.name: L-Mandelic Acid (5%)
key_actives.function: Larger-molecule AHA; exfoliates, brightens, improves texture with a lower irritation profile than glycolic acid.

key_actives.name: Azeloglicina® / Potassium Azelaoyl Diglycinate (3%)
key_actives.function: Tyrosinase inhibitor; fades dark spots, calms redness, regulates oil.

key_actives.name: Niacinamide
key_actives.function: Barrier support, tone-evening, calming.

key_actives.name: BioFense™ (Lactobacillus Ferment)
key_actives.function: Probiotic microbiome support, reduces acne-related redness.

key_actives.name: Synovea® HR (Hexylresorcinol)
key_actives.function: Brightener; works with niacinamide for cellular support.

products.how_to_use: After cleansing and toning, apply 3–5 drops to face, neck, and chest once daily (AM or PM). Layer with moisturizer. Apply SPF in the morning when using this product. Start with a lower frequency and build up if no dryness or sensitivity occurs.
products.description_short: A mandelic-acid leave-on exfoliant that brightens and refines texture while regulating oil — gentler than glycolic-based options.
products.image_alt: Skin Script Mandelic Brightening Serum on Dew Theory sage background

key_actives.function: Multi-depth hydration and plumping.

key_actives.name: Luminescine®

skin_types: all — best for normal, dry, combination, sensitive; less ideal for acne-prone due to nut oils

key_actives.name: Zinc Oxide (13.5%)
key_actives.function: Mineral, broad-spectrum UVA/UVB filter; sits on the skin's surface rather than being absorbed.

key_actives.name: Kukui Nut Oil & Macadamia Oil
key_actives.function: Fatty acids; nourishing, easily absorbed.

key_actives.name: Bisabolol, Sandalwood Extract, Phellodendron Amurense Bark Extract
key_actives.function: Calming, anti-inflammatory.

products.how_to_use: Apply in the morning after moisturizer, at least 30 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply every 2 hours. Not waterproof or sweatproof.
products.description_short: A mineral, zinc-oxide sunscreen formulated to sit sheer rather than leave a white cast.
products.source_conflict_note: One lower-authority source described a chemical-filter (octinoxate/octocrylene) version of this product. The large majority of sources — including the manufacturer's own product page — describe a 13.5% zinc-oxide-only mineral formula. This entry follows the majority/manufacturer version; flagged in case Skin Script has multiple SPF 30 SKUs.
